purpose: Synthetic prose-integrity counterexamples, not model-quality or production-validator proof

outcomes.name: same_numbers_do_not_preserve_negation
outcomes.observation: The same number appears in both sentences even though the outcome is reversed.

outcomes.name: high_similarity_does_not_preserve_meaning
outcomes.observation: A change reversing the claim still has over 90 percent character-sequence similarity.

outcomes.name: same_names_do_not_preserve_roles
outcomes.observation: Identical word inventory can reverse who performed the action.

outcomes.name: same_numeric_value_does_not_preserve_currency
outcomes.observation: Digit checking misses a currency change.

outcomes.name: same_numeric_value_does_not_preserve_period
outcomes.observation: Digit checking misses a material funding-period change.

outcomes.name: shortening_can_drop_material_conditions
outcomes.observation: A shorter grammatical sentence can remove the condition that made the statement true.

outcomes.name: lengthening_can_add_unsupported_history
outcomes.observation: One added word invents a previous meeting without adding any number or name.

outcomes.name: rephrasing_can_strengthen_uncertainty
outcomes.observation: Changing hope into certainty is material even when names and numbers stay fixed.

outcomes.name: word_count_is_not_language_neutral
outcomes.observation: Whitespace splitting is not a meaningful cross-language length metric.

outcomes.name: unicode_representation_is_not_character_count
outcomes.observation: Equivalent visible text may have distinct code point counts; arbitrary offsets can split a grapheme.

outcomes.name: browser_utf16_offset_is_not_python_codepoint_offset
outcomes.observation: UTF-16 code units and code points differ; raw offsets are not an editor-neutral selection identity.

outcomes.name: text_digest_alone_does_not_identify_target
outcomes.observation: Repeated text has the same digest in different blocks; stable semantic target identity is also needed.

outcomes.name: placeholder_set_equality_misses_duplication
outcomes.observation: A set comparison permits duplicated protected references; identity, multiplicity and structure matter.

outcomes.name: visible_text_diff_misses_link_target_change
outcomes.observation: Identical visible wording does not preserve the structured link destination.

outcomes.name: quote_attribution_does_not_authorize_rewriting
outcomes.observation: Keeping the speaker name does not preserve what the speaker actually said.

outcomes.name: same_target_id_does_not_authorize_stale_apply
outcomes.observation: An unchanged block ID does not make a suggestion generated from an old draft applicable.
